Name: site-zurich
Purpose: Non-ASCII description that must survive the round trip; the name itself cannot carry it

Name: empty-hold
Purpose: A report has to handle zero members without special-casing; its automember rule can never match

Name: lab-admins

Name: svc-accounts
Purpose: Every service account, and nothing human

Name: ext-partners
Description: Partner accounts from a trusted domain
Purpose: An external group: it can hold only trusted-domain SIDs, so it has no IPA members and no GID

Name: ext-partners-posix
Description: POSIX wrapper for the partner group
Purpose: The POSIX group the external one nests in, which is how a trust grants a GID; it has a member group and no users
